title: Redis timeouts / connection errors
steps: Check Redis server health dashboard (CPU, memory, evictions).
If timeouts persist, restart the Redis cluster primary.
Check application Redis client pool metrics.
Escalate to platform-team if not resolved in 30 minutes.
notes: Runbook last reviewed June 2025. Generic across services.

title: Database connection pool exhaustion
steps: Compare application pool utilization with Postgres CPU / max_connections.
Check for idle-in-transaction connections and recent deploys touching transactions.
If a recent deploy correlates, roll it back.
Restart pods to release leaked connections only after rollback.
Do not fail over Postgres unless the database itself is unhealthy.

title: Bad deployment / configuration
steps: If errors began within minutes of a deploy, compare config diff.
Roll back to the previous version.
Validate config in staging before re-deploying.

title: Payment provider latency
steps: Check PayFlow status page and upstream latency metrics.
If upstream p99 > 3s, open circuit breaker and route to CardStream.
Do not scale payment-api for upstream latency.

title: Memory leak / OOMKilled pods
steps: Check heap growth slope and recent deploys adding caches/listeners.
Rolling restart for relief; fix root cause (bound caches).
Raising memory limits only delays OOM.
